title: Amazing Andorra/Magnificent Montserrat!
text: Rodrigo was such an amazing guide-we had a wonderful day!! Seeing the Pyrenees up close was spectacular!
author: AmySH

title: Magic in Andorra and Montserrat
text: We enjoyed a perfect day in Andorra and Montserrat! Rodrigo was the best  guide imaginable. He was engaging, knowledgeable about history and the local cultures and language, and patient. He made learning about these magnificent destinations great fun. We would definitely recommend this beautiful tour again!!
author: Shelli_J

title: Outstanding day outside of Barcelona
text: Rodrigo was the most outstanding guide.  He picked us up at our hotel and took us to Montserrat with stops along the way.  He was exceptionally knowledgeable and knew just where to stop for the best photos as well as outstanding castles.  He was courteous and always concerned about exceeding our expectations.  He took us to an out of the way local restaurant for lunch in Andorra and also knew just where to go for the best pictures.  He always dropped us off at the site before parking and made us feel at home.  You don't want to miss this exceptional tour.
author: Robert_S

title: Great day to visit Andorra & Montserrat
text: Very enjoyable day to visit Andorra and Montaerrat. Our guide, Marian, shared much knowledge and insight about both locations.  Our driver, Julius, was equally as good.  It was a long day, 11+ hours, but was well worth it.
author: Adrian_F

title: Private tour to Andorra
text: Our guide/driver Rodrigo was prompt, efficient, knowledgeable, engaging.  Was concerned for our safety and comfort as he continually checked weather conditions.  Easy to relate to and personable. Tour to Montserrat was a welcome addition to the Andorra trip
author: Raymond_M

title: Great guide and tour company
text: This is a great tour if you only have one day to add Andorra to your list of countries and also visit Montserrat.  Rodrigo is a very experienced, outstanding guide.  Although it's several hours in the car, the drive is beautiful, and Rodrigo made the time pass quickly.  The tour company is well organized, and the communication was outstanding.  I had a wonderful time!
author: Cheryl_M
